about: Public schema of United Compute's GPU price data. One definition for the API (unitedcompute.ai/api/v1), the open dataset (github.com/United-Compute/gpu-price-tracker) and its mirrors. The export checks its columns against this file; the watchdog checks the live API against it.
license: CC BY 4.0. Attribution: United Compute, https://unitedcompute.ai

conventions.prices: USD per GPU per hour, for one GPU (single-GPU offers only). Other currencies are converted when collected.
conventions.csv: Empty cell = null. Booleans are true/false. `regions` is a JSON array in a text cell.
conventions.parquet: Same columns and order as the CSV. `regions` is a JSON text column.

offers.description: Current state: one row per offer (cloud x GPU product x cloud type x pricing). Rows are kept when an offer is sold out or disappears, so check `in_stock` and `fresh`.

fields.name: offer_id
fields.description: Stable id of the offer: cloud, the cloud's own product id, tier and pricing. Joins `offers`, `price_changes` and `daily_prices`.

fields.name: reseller
fields.description: true if the cloud resells other clouds' GPUs.

fields.name: via
fields.description: Platform the data comes through, e.g. Shadeform; null if read from the cloud directly.

fields.name: cloud_type
fields.description: datacenter (the cloud's own or partner data centers) or community (marketplace hosts).

fields.name: gpu_count
fields.description: Always 1: prices are for a single GPU.

fields.name: price_per_hour
fields.description: Price you can rent at now; null if sold out or not fresh.

fields.name: list_price_per_hour
fields.description: Advertised price, which may not be available.

fields.name: in_stock
fields.description: Rentable at the last check; null if not fresh.

fields.name: stock_level
fields.description: low, medium, high or available (cloud reports no level); null if not reported or not fresh.

fields.name: regions
fields.description: Where it is in stock: array of {id, location, stock}. id is a data center id or a 2-letter country code. Empty if not reported or not fresh.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Last time the collector saw this offer.

fields.name: changed_at
fields.description: Last time its price or stock changed.

fields.name: first_seen_at
fields.description: When the collector first saw this offer.

fields.name: fresh
fields.description: Checked within the last 2 hours. Offers that are not fresh have no current price or stock.

price_changes.description: Full history: one row each time an offer's price, stock or regions changed (checked every 15 minutes). The state holds until the next row for the same offer_id.

fields.name: price_per_hour
fields.description: Rentable price from this moment; null if sold out.

daily_prices.description: One row per offer and finished UTC day, computed from price_changes (time-weighted). Use this for charts and averages.

fields.name: price_min
fields.description: Lowest rentable price that day; null if never in stock.

fields.name: price_avg
fields.description: Average rentable price, weighted by time in stock.

fields.name: list_price_per_hour
fields.description: Advertised price at the end of the day.

fields.name: in_stock_share
fields.description: Share of the day (0-1) the offer was rentable, counted from when it was first seen.

index_daily.description: United Compute GPU Price Index, daily: median across clouds of each cloud's cheapest rentable on-demand price for one GPU (resellers excluded). Method: https://unitedcompute.ai/gpu-price-index#methodology

fields.name: close
fields.description: Index value at the end of the day.

fields.name: clouds
fields.description: Clouds in the index at the close.

fields.name: marketplace
fields.description: true for marketplaces, where hosts list their own machines.

fields.name: added_at
fields.description: When the collector started reading this cloud.
